mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eval_task (task_id, task_name, eval_type, dataset_id, status, total_count, completed_count, model_version, rag_strategy_version, avg_overall_score, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{taskName}, #{evalType}, #{datasetId}, #{status}, #{totalCount}, #{completedCount}, #{modelVersion}, #{ragStrategyVersion}, #{avgOverallScore}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE eval_task SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
UPDATE eval_task SET completed_count = #{completedCount}, avg_overall_score = #{avgOverallScore}, update_time = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
UPDATE eval_task SET total_count = #{totalCount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
